note: Data-only trigger-routing fixtures (plugin-wide-6 / batch C4). There is no built-in eval runner; these cases are the fresh-session A/B baseline corpus recorded BEFORE the C1 description POV batch. Post-run user-verification artifact, not a merge gate. Expected behaviours rewritten for 0.20.0 (live sources instead of a mapping snapshot).

evals.prompt: 把 /think 轉成 codex 版
evals.expected_behavior: Port mode for a single skill: lists the component kinds present, looks each up in the current official docs (and the Codex source at the release tag where the docs are silent), follows the repo's mirror conventions, changes only structure while keeping every trigger phrase and the alignment tooth, then audits the result and runs the parity script.

evals.prompt: Port this plugin to codex so my teammate can use it
evals.expected_behavior: Plugin shape: records the Claude Code and Codex versions, looks up manifest, bundled agents, hooks, and Claude-only components at their current sources, records author-owned choices under 待查 instead of picking, names every omitted component, and cites a URL or path@tag for each rule.

evals.prompt: porting 到 Codex 時 disable-model-invocation 要怎麼對應？
evals.expected_behavior: Question mode: answers this one mapping from the current Codex docs or source, citing it, rather than from memory.

evals.prompt: 把這個 Codex prompt 轉回 Claude skill
evals.expected_behavior: Reverse porting (Codex→Claude) is out of scope — the skill is one-way.

evals.prompt: 從零幫我寫一個全新的 Codex skill
evals.expected_behavior: Authoring a brand-new Codex skill that isn't a port of an existing Claude source is out of scope.

evals.prompt: 優化這個 skill 的 SKILL.md
evals.expected_behavior: Improving an existing SKILL.md routes to /evolve.

evals.prompt: 幫我檢查 codex/plugins 底下的 Codex 版跟 Claude 版有沒有對齊
evals.expected_behavior: Audit mode (default, read-only): compares the hand-maintained pair against the platforms' current sources and the repo's mirror conventions, returns the 繁中 parity report with a source for every rule and Next-port follow-ups; edits nothing.
